 10:00 PM ET Last update 9:34 PM ET 9:34 PM ET 8 minutes ago Players to Watch
 For the Los Angeles Lakers, Luka Dončić will be the player to watch. The Slovenian started the season with 28 points, eight rebounds, and seven assists against the Golden State Warriors. His ability to create plays, take advantage of screens, and find openings against opposing defenses will be crucial to the offense led by JJ Redick.
 For the LA Clippers, Darius Garland will be in the spotlight after scoring 30 points in the victory over the Sacramento Kings. The point guard will be key to the team's offensive creation and perimeter game as Tyronn Lue's squad looks to use his speed and scoring ability to challenge the Lakers' defense.

 9:00 PM ET 42 minutes ago A Battle of LA with plenty at stake
 Although the regular season is only just beginning, this matchup represents an opportunity to establish an early advantage in Los Angeles. The Clippers will look to build on their promising start, while the Lakers aim to take advantage of home-court advantage and secure their second consecutive victory.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 8:51 PM ET an hour ago Keys to the game
 The Clippers will need to find a way to contain Dončić, LeBron James, and Reaves, three players capable of creating mismatches and dictating the Lakers' offensive rhythm.
 On the other side, the connection between Garland and Leonard will be crucial for the visitors. Perimeter defense, rebounding, and shooting efficiency could determine the outcome of a matchup between two teams that began the season with a win.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 8:35 PM ET an hour ago Head-to-head history between the Lakers and Clippers
 The Los Angeles rivalry has a long history in the NBA. Across 247 regular-season meetings, the Lakers have recorded 158 wins, compared with 89 for the Clippers.
 However, the 2025-26 season series ended in a 2-2 tie. The most recent meeting took place on February 20, 2026, when the Lakers earned a 125-122 victory at Crypto.com Arena. Dončić stood out with 38 points and 11 assists, while Kawhi Leonard scored 31 points for the Clippers.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 7:55 PM ET 2 hours ago Los Angeles Lakers: Luka Dončić leads the offense
 The Lakers enter the season with high ambitions after finishing the previous campaign with a record of 53 wins and 29 losses. The team will look to maintain its consistency and secure a favorable position heading into the playoffs.
 Dončić opened the season with 28 points, eight rebounds, and seven assists against Golden State. Alongside LeBron James and Austin Reaves, he will be one of the team's main offensive threats, while DeAndre Ayton, Marcus Smart, and Rui Hachimura will provide additional options in different areas of the court.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 7:10 PM ET 3 hours ago Los Angeles Clippers: Darius Garland leads the way
 The Clippers are looking to establish themselves among the Western Conference's competitive teams after finishing last season with 42 wins and 40 losses. Their goal is to finish among the conference's top six teams and secure direct qualification for the playoffs.
 Garland opened the campaign with 30 points against Sacramento, while Kawhi Leonard remains one of the team's leading stars and Brook Lopez brings experience to the paint. The team will monitor the medical status of Brandon Ingram, Bradley Beal, and Max Strus, who remain under observation. Jordan Miller continues to be sidelined after undergoing shoulder surgery.
 Live updates by Sebastian Raquira Avellaneda
 7:10 PM ET 3 hours ago Two teams that started the season in commanding fashion
 The Lakers opened their campaign on Wednesday, October 21, with a 127-105 victory over the Golden State Warriors. Luka Dončić led the offense, supported by Austin Reaves and DeAndre Ayton.
 The Clippers, meanwhile, defeated the Sacramento Kings 121-96 at Intuit Dome. Darius Garland shined with 30 points and led a collective performance that left positive impressions in the team's season opener under head coach Tyronn Lue.

 Crypto.com Arena will host the first matchup between the Clippers and Lakers this season. Both franchises opened their campaigns with convincing victories and will look to maintain their strong form in one of the most attractive matchups in the Western Conference.
